s1.ptxt: Apply parking brake and block wheels.
Set ignition “ON” and shift select lever to N range.
Remove adjuster case (cable end) from select lever pin of select lever assembly.
Release lock plate (1) which restricts moving of lock piece (2).
Pull out lock piece from adjuster case (3) using pliers to disengage cable.
Check that “N” position of select lever is in suitable position.
Shift select lever to N range.
Check that positioning protrusion (2) on manual select lever (1) is pointing to “N” position on TCM (3).
Apply grease to select lever pin (1), and then install select lever pin securely into adjuster case (2).
Push lock piece (3) in arrow direction [a] as shown in figure.
Slide lock plate (4) in arrow direction [b] as shown in figure until gets over the claw (5).
After installing select cable, check the following points.

item.ptxt: Check that back up light turns on when shifting select lever to R range.
Check that shift position indicated on information display is consistent with select lever range.
Check that engine starts in P and N ranges and does not start in other ranges.
